message: Filled in `clamp` per the marker's own spec: raises `ValueError` when `low > high`, otherwise returns `value` bounded to `[low, high]` using builtin `min`/`max`. No new definitions or renames needed.
diff:
diff --git a/mathutil.py b/mathutil.py
index dd892d7..e613a1a 100644
--- a/mathutil.py
+++ b/mathutil.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 def clamp(value: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
-    # raise ValueError if low > high
-    ...
+    if low > high:
+        raise ValueError("low must not be greater than high")
+    return max(low, min(value, high))
